name: The St. Regis Aspen
positioning: The St. Regis Aspen Resort: a mountain resort at the base of Aspen Mountain, a short walk from the slopes, with St. Regis butler service and a heated outdoor pool overlooking the mountain
best_for: Skiers who want to be a short walk from the base of Aspen Mountain
Food and wine lovers: the resort is a host hotel for the FOOD and WINE Classic in Aspen
Suite guests who want butler service

facts.text: The St. Regis Aspen Resort is located at the base of Aspen Mountain, close to both the town and the mountain.
The hotel is a three-minute walk from the base of Aspen Mountain, or five minutes in ski boots.
The resort has a heated outdoor pool and hot tubs that overlook Aspen Mountain.
The spa includes the Confluence, reminiscent of the hot springs in Colorado.
Velvet Buck uses local, seasonal ingredients in a fusion of multiple cuisines and serves breakfast daily.
Apres Tea in Mountain Social Bar & Lounge is inspired by Caroline Astor, with an alpine twist.
Rooms, suites and residences have 400-thread-count Frette linens and marble bathrooms.
Two-bedroom suites have living space, fireplaces and kitchenettes.
St. Regis Butler Service is available 24 hours a day.
Ski valets help with ski and snowboard equipment and offer local knowledge of terrain and conditions.
The hotel partners with the Aspen Outfitting Company for guided activities including fly fishing and clay target shooting.
Four ski mountains are within reach: Snowmass, Aspen, Aspen Highlands and Buttermilk.

highlights.text: The resort is a host hotel for the FOOD and WINE Classic in Aspen.
Mountain Social Bar & Lounge hosts a daily champagne sabering.
The hotel's local take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary is the Downhill Snapper, made with dill, basil and citrus.
The Silver Circle Ice Rink is adjacent to the hotel.
For suite guests, butlers handle unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing and shoeshine.

considerations.text: Aspen's ski and snowboard season runs from about Thanksgiving weekend to the first few weeks of April.
Aspen-Pitkin County Airport is about 3 miles from the hotel, and the hotel has an airport shuttle to it.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and peak demand during ski season.
